name: hop
description: Hop: a hop game to play while Claude works, with an AI coding tip on every block / 蹦一蹦：等 Claude 干活时玩的跳一跳，每块方块带一张 AI 编程知识卡片

autoHint.title: Hint while Claude works / Claude 干活时提示
autoHint.description: Show a hint above the prompt when a turn runs for a while / Claude 一轮跑了一会儿，在输入框上方提示可以玩一局

hintAfterSeconds.title: Hint after (seconds) / 多少秒后提示
hintAfterSeconds.description: Seconds into a turn before the hint shows / 一轮开始多少秒后出现提示

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself / 自动打开面板
autoOpen.description: Open the game pane instead of only hinting / 到时间直接打开游戏面板，而不只是提示

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: auto follows the system language; zh or en forces Chinese or English / auto 跟随系统语言，zh 或 en 强制中文或英文
